nodes.title: ExpressLRS: Signal Health (sensitivity limit per packet rate)
nodes.where: 2.4 GHz table: 50 Hz -115, 100 Hz Full -112, 150 Hz -112, 250 Hz -108, 333 Hz Full -105, 500 Hz -105 dBm; RSSI alarm 5-10 dB above the limit

nodes.title: ArduPilot: Crossfire and ELRS RC systems
nodes.where: CRSF mode: SERIALx_PROTOCOL 23, RSSI_TYPE 3, RC_OPTIONS bit 13 (420 kbaud for ELRS), UART must have DMA on F4/F7, TX must transmit before the RX powers up; MAVLink mode: SERIALx_PROTOCOL 2, RSSI_TYPE 5, WiFi forwarding from the TX module

nodes.title: ExpressLRS: MAVLink mode (3.5+, TX Backpack 1.5+)
nodes.where: ESP-based RX only; telemetry ratio fixed 1:2; internal TX modules reach the GCS through the TX backpack WiFi. Read through a search summary only

nodes.title: RadioMaster Pocket user manual (ELRS version)
nodes.where: internal ELRS 25-250 mW (FCC), 100 mW at 500 Hz recommended; 2 x 18650 not included. Read through a search summary; BOM line R01 names the 'Pocket Crush' variant: I1 confirms it is the same module

nodes.title: RadioMaster RP3 V2 ELRS 2.4 GHz nano receiver (retailer listings)
nodes.where: antenna diversity, two 65 mm T-antennas (UFL), telemetry up to 100 mW, TCXO, 5 V, CRSF, 4.6 g, 22 x 13 x 4 mm. Maker page returned 429; values from 3 retailer listings that agree

nodes.title: 47 CFR 15.247, operation in 902-928, 2400-2483.5, 5725-5850 MHz
nodes.where: (b)(1): 1 W conducted for FHSS in 2400-2483.5 MHz with >= 75 hopping channels; (b)(4): 6 dBi antenna allowance, i.e. 36 dBm EIRP

nodes.title: Centre of the 2.4 GHz ISM band
nodes.text: Link frequency for path loss 2 440 MHz
nodes.basis: ELRS hops 2 400-2 480 MHz; path loss differs by < 0.3 dB across the band

nodes.title: ELRS 150 Hz LoRa, telemetry 1:4, Wide switches
nodes.text: Packet rate 150 Hz, sensitivity -112 dBm; telemetry ratio 1:4 (37.5 Hz downlink for CRSF passthrough); switch mode Wide
nodes.basis: 150 Hz gives 4 dB more margin than 250 Hz at a 6.7 ms frame, ample for a 2.6 kg wing; ArduPilot passthrough wants >= 25 Hz telemetry (discuss.ardupilot.org CRSF thread)

nodes.title: Flight TX power 100 mW fixed; check power 25 mW
nodes.text: TX power fixed at 100 mW (20 dBm), dynamic power off; ground range check at the Pocket's lowest setting 25 mW (14 dBm)
nodes.basis: Pocket manual: 25-250 mW, 100 mW recommended; fixed power makes logs comparable flight to flight

nodes.title: Antenna gains 0 dBi each end
nodes.text: TX and RX antenna gain taken as 0 dBi (dipoles are ~2 dBi; nulls and cable loss eat it)
nodes.basis: conservative; the range check measures it

nodes.title: Implementation loss 16 dB
nodes.text: Airframe shadowing by the pack, spar and tubes 8 dB, polarisation mismatch (the aircraft turns 90 deg at transition) 3 dB, pilot body and ground multipath 5 dB
nodes.basis: engineering estimate for a small UAV at < 120 m AGL; the ground range check in two attitudes replaces it with a measured value

nodes.title: Fade margin >= 10 dB
nodes.text: Required uplink margin above sensitivity at the design distance
nodes.basis: ELRS guidance warns 5-10 dB above the limit; 10 dB covers a deep fade and keeps the warning alarm above the failsafe point

nodes.title: ELRS link-loss detection 1.0 s
nodes.text: Time from the last good uplink packet to the RX stopping CRSF channel frames
nodes.basis: ELRS disconnects after roughly 1 s without packets at 150 Hz; measured on the bench (T-F5-FS-BENCH)

nodes.title: ArduPilot FS_SHORT_TIMEOUT 1.5 s
nodes.text: Plane short RC failsafe after 1.5 s of no RC input (default, kept by K09L.param)

nodes.title: Antenna clearance >= lambda/4
nodes.text: Active element of each RX antenna at least a quarter wavelength from carbon, the pack, ESC leads and the other antenna element
nodes.basis: common practice for dipoles near conductors (detuning, pattern null)

nodes.title: Uplink budget at the VLOS limit at 400 ft
nodes.equation: d = sqrt(vlos^2 + h^2); Prx = Ptx + Gtx + Grx - FSPL(f, d) - L; margin = Prx - S

nodes.title: Ground range-check RSSI pass line
nodes.equation: RSSI_req = S + M + 20 log10(d_req / d_test) - (P_op - P_test); predicted = P_test - FSPL(d_test) - L

nodes.title: Switch latency and RC-loss-to-failsafe time
nodes.equation: t_switch = (aux_slots + 1) / rate / LQ; t_fs = t_elrs + FS_SHORT_TIMEOUT

nodes.title: Maximum EIRP the Pocket can radiate
Design link distance (VLOS limit at the 400 ft ceiling)
nodes.how: Geometry: sqrt(500^2 + 121.9^2). The 250 m fence (F4) keeps flights inside 273 m slant.

nodes.title: Uplink fade margin at 100 mW, 150 Hz, at the VLOS limit
nodes.how: Flight logs (RSSI, RXLQ) at the farthest point of each fixed-wing flight: 1RSS/2RSS >= -102 dBm and LQ >= 0.9 (T-F5-FLIGHT-LINK); ground check T-F5-RANGE first.

nodes.title: Range at which the modelled margin reaches 0 dB
nodes.how: Information only: shows the VLOS limit, not the radio, bounds the operating radius.

nodes.title: Range check pass line: RX RSSI at 100 m, 25 mW
nodes.how: T-F5-RANGE: better of 1RSS/2RSS at 100 m, 25 mW, in both hover and cruise attitude, >= this value and LQ >= 0.9; this proves >= 10 dB margin at 515 m and 100 mW.

nodes.title: Predicted RX RSSI at the range check
nodes.how: Compare with the measured RSSI in T-F5-RANGE; a shortfall means the 16 dB implementation loss is optimistic (move the antennas, CR to D2/F3).

nodes.title: Transmitter RSSI warning alarm
nodes.how: EdgeTX telemetry alarm on 1RSS; check it sounds when the TX is shielded.

nodes.title: Transmitter RSSI critical alarm
nodes.how: EdgeTX telemetry alarm on 1RSS; 5 dB above the -112 dBm limit.

nodes.title: Minimum RX antenna clearance to carbon, pack and ESC leads
nodes.how: Ruler on the installed pod: each 30 mm active element >= 31 mm from the CF spar, pack and power leads; one element vertical (z), one along x.

nodes.title: Worst-case switch-channel (e-stop ch 9) link latency
nodes.how: SITL S13 / bench: flip ch 9, read RCIN in the DataFlash log against the motor outputs (props off).

nodes.title: Transmitter off to ArduPilot RC failsafe
nodes.how: T-F5-FS-BENCH: props off, armed in QSTABILIZE, switch the TX off; log time to the FS message.

nodes.title: Pocket EIRP at its maximum setting
nodes.how: 47 CFR 15.247(b): 30 dBm conducted + 6 dBi = 36 dBm. Read the FCC ID on the Pocket and RP3 labels on arrival; keep the FCC (not LBT, not unlocked) ELRS regulatory domain.

nodes.title: RC, telemetry and GCS spend beyond BOM lines A03, R01, R02
nodes.how: BOM.csv: A03 $22.04 + R01 $71.65 + R02 $27.00 incl. tax = $120.69 already carried; the only addition is a pair of 150 mm U.FL 2.4 GHz T-antennas for the RP3 V2 (CR-F3-15: stock 65 mm leads do not reach the hatch-top and nose tubes). I1 prices it at order (CR-F5-11). Telemetry rides on the ELRS link and the GCS is Mission Planner on a team laptop (no purchase).
nodes.note: Estimate from CR-F3-15 (~$6), UNVERIFIED until I1 fetches a listing. The pessimistic reserve is $312.99 vs the $309 crash (+$3.99, D-57), so A1 pulls I1's first lever (borrow the soldering kit, +$94.82). A 915 MHz SiK pair (~$35-60) stays out

nodes.title: Arrival bench: versions, bind, model match, channel map
nodes.procedure: ELRS TX and RX on the same major version (3.x), FCC domain; binding phrase set (kept off the repo); model match on, K09-L and twin have different model ids; RC calibration in Mission Planner; every channel moves the right way; ch 9 latency from the log.

nodes.title: Bench RC failsafe, props off
nodes.procedure: Armed in QSTABILIZE, FBWA and CRUISE in turn (props off, tied down), TX off: QLAND in Q modes, circle then RTL at 5 s in FW; time from TX off to the FS message <= 2.5 s.

nodes.title: Ground range check, two attitudes
nodes.procedure: 25 mW, 150 Hz; aircraft 1 m above ground on a stand, motors spinning props-off at 20 %; at 100 m read 1RSS/2RSS/RQly for 4 headings in hover attitude and 4 in cruise attitude.

nodes.title: In-flight link log review
nodes.procedure: After each flight: plot RSSI and RXLQ vs distance from home (DataFlash RSSI msg, EdgeTX SD log); min LQ >= 0.9, min RSSI >= -102 dBm at the farthest point.
